summary: All seven browser UI outcomes are implemented and verified in Writer and Calc.
findings: Registered Calc commands remain visible through temporary disabled states; disconnected controls and empty menu branches are pruned in the presentation.
Real browser runs confirmed stable font geometry, immediate tooltips, separated menu checkmarks, and rendered progress during file import and browser-storage reopen.
evidence_refs: 155 unit tests and 59 distinct Playwright cases covering final behavior
